chunks: So prepare your strategy and come forward. He alone shall win today who is superior.

key_terms.اسْتَعْلَى: he who is superior or attains victory

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'He alone shall win today who is superior' mean in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as a divine challenge to the Quraysh, with 'success' (ist'la) interpreted not merely as political dominance but as spiritual victory through steadfastness, particularly realized by Imam al-Husayn (AS) at Karbala. The phrase 'then come in a row' highlights the organized yet ultimately futile opposition against the truth, reinforcing the concept that true elevation comes from aligning with God's will rather than worldly power.
